import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int N;
    static String[] mat;
    static String[] mat2;
    static int[][] v1;
    static int[] dx = {-1,0,1,0};
    static int[] dy = {0,1,0,-1};
    static MinCostMaxFlow mcf = new MinCostMaxFlow();

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int Nodes;
        int[] cost, flow, p;
        ArrayList<Node> edges;
        int tot_cost, tot_flow;
        final int INF = 1000000000;

        class Node {
            int from, to, cost, flow;
            Node(int _from, int _to, int _cost, int _flow) {
                from = _from; to = _to; cost = _cost; flow = _flow;
            }
        }

        Pair<Integer,Integer> get_pair() {
            return new Pair<>(tot_cost, tot_flow);
        }
        int get_flow() { return tot_flow; }
        int get_cost() { return tot_cost; }

        void clear(int n) {
            Nodes = n;
            cost = new int[n];
            flow = new int[n];
            p = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(cost, INF);
            Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            edges.add(new Node(from, to, cost, flow));
            edges.add(new Node(to, from, -cost, 0));
        }

        void get_path(int src, int sink) {
            clear(Nodes);
            flow[src] = INF;
            cost[src] = 0;
            boolean f;
            for (int i = 0; i < Nodes; i++) {
                f = false;
                for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                    Node e = edges.get(j);
                    if (e.flow > 0 && cost[e.to] > cost[e.from] + e.cost) {
                        f = true;
                        cost[e.to] = cost[e.from] + e.cost;
                        flow[e.to] = Math.min(flow[e.from], e.flow);
                        p[e.to] = j;
                    }
                }
                if (!f) break;
            }
        }

        void cost_flow(int src, int sink) {
            if (src == sink) { tot_cost = 0; tot_flow = INF; return; }
            tot_cost = 0;
            tot_flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                get_path(src, sink);
                if (flow[sink] == 0) break;
                for (int cur = sink; cur != src; cur = edges.get(p[cur]).from) {
                    int rI = p[cur] ^ 1;
                    edges.get(p[cur]).flow -= flow[sink];
                    edges.get(rI).flow += flow[sink];
                    tot_cost += edges.get(p[cur]).cost * flow[sink];
                }
                tot_flow += flow[sink];
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair<A,B> {
        A first; B second;
        Pair(A a, B b) { first = a; second = b; }
    }

    static void ff(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(x * N + y);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            x = cur / N;
            y = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v[nx][ny] != -1 || mat[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y')
                    continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2[nx].charAt(ny)) && mat2[nx].charAt(ny) != '0' &&
                    (v[x][y] + 1 <= v1[nx][ny] || v1[nx][ny] == -1)) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[x][y] + 1;
                    if (v[nx][ny] != v1[nx][ny])
                        q.add(nx * N + ny);
                } else if (v1[nx][ny] == -1 || v1[nx][ny] > v[x][y] + 1) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ini(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v[i], -1);
        v[x][y] = 0;
        ff(x, y, v);
    }

    static void get(String[] m, ArrayList<int[][]> vv) {
        vv.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) vv.add(null);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m[i].charAt(j)) && m[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    int[][] v = new int[N][N];
                    ini(i, j, v);
                    vv.set(i * N + j, v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int n1 = i * N + j;
        int n2 = x * N + y + N * N;
        mcf.add_edge(2 * n1 + 1, 2 * n2, 0, 1000000);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        N = n;
        String[] a = new String[n];
        String[] b = new String[n];
        int si = 0, sj = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = sc.next();
        mat = a;
        mat2 = b;
        v1 = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v1[i], 1000000);
        int[][] v = new int[N][N];
        ini(si, sj, v);
        v1 = v;
        ArrayList<int[][]> vv = new ArrayList<>();
        get(a, vv);
        mcf.clear(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.add_edge(src, 2 * i, 0, 1000000);
            mcf.add_edge(2 * (N * N + i) + 1, src + 1, 0, 1000000);
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[x].charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.add_edge(2 * k, 2 * k + 1, 0, a[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(b[x].charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.add_edge(2 * k, 2 * k + 1, 0, b[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i].charAt(j)) && b[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        if (vv.get(k) != null) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (vv.get(k)[i][j] != -1 && vv.get(k)[i][j] <= t) {
                                add_edge(x, y, i, j);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        mcf.cost_flow(src, src + 1);
        System.out.println(mcf.get_flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
